title: The no-shard test does not depend on thread finish order
why: hooks/test_mutate_shared.py ShardTests.test_no_shard_runs_all asserts ran == ["a","b","c"], but mutate_shared.run_mutants runs entries on a ThreadPoolExecutor, so ran fills in finish order. Under a loaded lane-lint run it failed twice for lane mail-read-receipt (#3137, 10:26 CST Nov 13) with ["a","c","b"]. Alone it passes (6 of 6 on main). It is a flaky test, not red on main.
source: lane mail-read-receipt 10:26 CST Nov 13; triage read of main 7dd44c41c
note: Fix: compare sorted(ran) to the entries, as test_shards_together_run_each_mutant_once already does. A test-author changes the test; product code is unchanged. Done when: the test passes with run_one made to finish in reverse order. Lane shard-order-test-flake (session_013NEJL3evMsAfVyfowLBaoK), started by the coordinator 10:42 CST Nov 13.
